text: Walking past the glass-walled meeting room, I am struck by the sterile order of the empty chairs and tables. The silence feels contemplative, the anticipation of potential discussions hangs in the air. Then, entering the vivid exhibition space filled with bold colors and glowing screens, my senses awaken. The ideas of research and development invite curiosity, promising discovery and innovation. I feel a sense of transition—from silent possibility to active inquiry—wondering how human ingenuity is always on display, just waiting for the next inspired mind to engage.
